topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: I shuffled through the rows of old toys, each one a whisper of a life lived long ago. Suddenly, there it was, sitting on a faded sheet, my childhood friend. The bear’s fur, once a brilliant white, now carried the patina of time, its eyes a bit dulled, but still, it was unmistakably mine. I picked it up, and the weight, the texture, felt like a piece of my past weighing down on me. It’s strange to think of the stories we could tell, this bear and I, of the nights it comforted me, the days it stood by, silent and steadfast. Now, here we are, both a little more worn, a little more quiet. I wrapped it carefully in my arms, a bridge to a time when the world was simpler, softer.
